issues.justification: 'Редиска' (nasty/bad guy, a mild slang term that is a running gag) is rendered as 'rat', which collides with 'rat' later used for 'сдавать/раскалываться' contexts and loses the comic euphemistic quality; the gag of the glossary lesson is also muddled because 'rat' and 'spill his guts' blur.

issues.source_quote: Нам не страшен серый волк... Я злой и страшный серый волк, я в поросятах знаю толк.
issues.translation_quote: I'm the wicked, fearsome big bad wolf. I know a thing or two about piglets.
issues.justification: Acceptable, but the culturally famous Three Little Pigs song reference is flattened; minor loss of rhyme/song feel.

issues.translation_quote: That's it! Show's over. The power's out.
issues.justification: The well-known Russian cinema-mechanic joke phrase 'Кина не будет' is rendered neutrally, losing the colloquial/comic flavor; acceptable but weak.

issues.source_quote: Чего? - Пасть порву... В угол поставлю!
issues.translation_quote: I'll make you stand in the corner!
issues.justification: Fine; the kindergarten-teacher habit crossing into thief-talk is preserved.

issues.source_quote: Сколько я зарезал, сколько перерезал, сколько душ я загубил!
issues.translation_quote: How many have I stabbed and slaughtered? How many souls have I destroyed?
issues.justification: The line is a famous parody of a melodramatic prison song/Don Juan-style boast, delivered by a comic character (Troshkin as Nikola of Petersburg); the exaggerated rhythmic parody is flattened into plain prose.

issues.translation_quote: Come on, man! Are you deaf?

issues.justification: Slightly off; 'You're something else!' would fit.

issues.source_quote: Эй, гражданина! Ты туда не ходи, ты сюда ходи, а то снег башка попадет - совсем мертвый будешь!
issues.translation_quote: Hey, citizen! Don't go that way. Go this way. Snow falls on head that way. You end up completely dead!
issues.justification: Good imitation of broken Russian, but 'Snow falls on head' dropped the 'will' flavor; fine.
Chess terminology fine; but 'Fancy a game of chess' for 'Может козла забьем?' mistranslates: 'козла забить' means playing dominoes.
